    AGENTS.md: hyperannotatR

    Source: AGENTS.md

    Instructions for coding agents working in this repository. For the current state of the work and what to do next, read planning/HANDOVER.md first (in the source checkout).

    What this package is

    hyperannotatR (renamed from annotatR in 0.3.0) is an R package for multi-layer region-of-interest (ROI) annotation of hyperspectral imaging (HSI) data: spectral cubes (ENVI, TIVITA, Cubert, NPY), band views, spectral extraction and their display rasters. ROIs are validated sf geometries in image pixel coordinates with explicit pyramid-level transforms. They rasterise to binary, labelled, multiclass or bitfield masks. A Shiny batch annotation app with a canvas htmlwidget, a versioned partner contract (handoff directories, training datasets) and an optional local control service complete it.

    Scope boundary: histology and cell-level annotation (microscopy cell or nucleus annotation, segmentation, correction, training, review) belongs to the sibling package segmantR, which carries its own copy of the ROI, mask and canvas code (sg_roi_*, sg_canvas). Do not add histology-specific features here. The QuPath bridge qupflowR names hyperannotatR as its annotation partner through the annotatr-control-v1 contract.

    Layout

    • R/: package code. Exported functions use the at_ prefix and S3 classes the annot_ prefix (annot_roi, annot_layer, annot_project, annot_image, annot_mask, annot_session). Areas:
      • classes: class-*.R, hyperannotatR-classes.R;
      • geometry: geometry.R;
      • masks: mask*.R, agree.R;
      • image backends: backend*.R, io-window.R, io-binary.R, io-tiff-process.R, hsi-meta.R;
      • interchange: io-geojson.R, io-qupath.R, io-csv.R, io-npy.R;
      • persistence: persistence.R, io-project.R, export-policy.R;
      • partner contracts: interop-*.R, training.R, schema-validate.R;
      • control service: control-*.R;
      • app: app-*.R, widget-canvas.R.
    • inst/htmlwidgets/atcanvas.js: the canvas widget. inst/shiny/hyperannotatR/www/: app assets (keys.js, custom.css, logo). inst/schema/: JSON schemas of the partner contracts. inst/extdata/: example images.
    • tests/testthat/: unit and regression tests (testthat edition 3).
      • helper-fresh-process.R (audit_fresh()) runs code in a new R process, loading the installed build under R CMD check and covr.
      • helper-tiff-writer.R writes TIFF layouts that tiff::writeTIFF() cannot.
      • fixtures/: byte-pinned test data.
    • tests/audit/: fast node tests of the canvas and keyboard JavaScript.
    • tests/browser/: real-browser Playwright runners and their R fixtures (see tests/browser/README.md).
    • tests/qualification/: manual qualification scripts (Linux memory, Windows host, QuPath round trip, installed-process checks). They are not run by R CMD check.
    • planning/: roadmap, finding registers and dated evidence. Build-ignored.
    • data-raw/: generators for example data and fixtures.

    Commands

    Run from the package root. R 4.6.1 is the tested version; DESCRIPTION claims R (>= 4.1.0), which is unverified.

    # Full test suite (about 5 minutes; 832 tests, 9 expected skips without optional software)
NOT_CRAN=true Rscript -e 'testthat::test_local(".")'

# One file
NOT_CRAN=true Rscript -e 'pkgload::load_all(); testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-mask.R")'

# Canvas and keyboard JavaScript
node --test tests/audit/widget.test.js tests/audit/keyboard.test.js

# Real-browser lane (shinytest2 + chromote); needs a Chromium-based browser
NOT_CRAN=true ANNOTATR_BROWSER_TESTS=true CHROMOTE_CHROME=/path/to/chrome \
  Rscript -e 'pkgload::load_all(); testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-app-browser.R")'

# Playwright runners: start the R fixture, then the node runner (see tests/browser/README.md)
Rscript tests/browser/app-journey.R &   # port 5819; ANNOTATR_BROWSER_PORT overrides
PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=/path/to/node_modules/playwright CHROMIUM_PATH=/path/to/chrome \
  node tests/browser/app-journey.cjs

# Documentation: roxygen2 must be exactly 8.0.0 (Config/roxygen2/version)
Rscript -e 'roxygen2::roxygenise()'

# R CMD check from a clean export (R CMD build copies ignored local data otherwise)
git archive HEAD | tar -x -C /tmp/hyperannotatR-export
R CMD build --no-manual /tmp/hyperannotatR-export
_R_CHECK_FORCE_SUGGESTS_=false R CMD check --as-cran --no-manual hyperannotatR_*.tar.gz

# CTTIR house linters (config shared in the sibling CTTIR/.github checkout)
Rscript -e 'source("../.github/config/lint-cttir.R"); print(lintr::lint_package(linters = cttir_linters()))'

    Expected results at 72e2b7d: - R CMD check --as-cran gives Status: 1 NOTE, New submission only. - The house lint reports 1 finding in package code (at_fix_geometry(verbose =), an open decision) and 57 in tests, examples and vignettes.

    README.md is generated from README.Rmd. Install the package into a scratch library, then render with rmarkdown::render("README.Rmd", output_format = rmarkdown::github_document(html_preview = FALSE)). Plots use ragg when installed so that colours are exact.

    System requirements: - GDAL, GEOS, PROJ and udunits (for sf and stars); - ImageMagick (magick, PNG/JPEG); - libtiff (tiff).

    Optional software: - terra, RBioFormats with Java (OME-TIFF); - the Cubert CUVIS SDK (cuvis.r); - a Chromium build, node and Playwright for the browser lanes.

    Tests whose prerequisites are missing skip with a named reason.

    Invariants: do not change

    • Stored identifiers keep their pre-rename spelling. Files written by this package and by annotatR carry them, and the partners and segmantR read them:
      • annotatR_version;
      • the coordinate schema annotatR-pixel-level-v1;
      • the QuPath metadata keys annotatR_roi_id, annotatR_coordinate_schema and annotatR_coordinate_level, plus the lower-case annotatr_* keys;
      • the QuPath object-id seed "annotatR:roi:" in .roi_uuid();
      • all lower-case contract ids (annotatr-handoff-v1, annotatr-control-v1, annotatr-hsi-v1, …).
      A blanket rename once broke these. Tests in test-qupath-native.R and test-io-qupath-real.R now guard them.
    • Options use the hyperannotatR.* prefix. The old annotatR.* names are not read. Test environment variables keep the ANNOTATR_* prefix.
    • Byte-pinned fixtures (MD5SUMS, SHA256SUMS, sha256.json, *.sha256 under tests/testthat/fixtures and tests/fixtures) change only through their generators, with every pin updated. .gitattributes marks fixtures -text so that Windows checkouts keep their bytes.
    • planning/evidence/<date>/ is a historical record. Never edit existing logs. New runs go into a new dated folder with a README table (File | Command | Result). Redact machine paths (<check-dir>, $TMPDIR).
    • Wire formats and contracts are versioned. Changing a schema under inst/schema means a new contract version and matching changes in qupflowR.

    Conventions

    • Errors are classified conditions: use .at_abort() or .at_fail() with a class and a code, giving at_<class>_error. Tests assert err$code.
    • Regression tests must fail before the fix. Prove it by running them against the unfixed code. Behaviour that only shows on an installed build, such as namespace loading, needs a fresh-process test (audit_fresh()).
    • Paths in tests are compared in canonical form (normalizePath(x, winslash = "/")). Windows CI runs the suite.
    • User-visible changes go under the top section of NEWS.md.
      • Finding ids: A01–A35 are in planning/ADDITIONAL-FINDINGS.md; V/C/M/I/X/S/W/D are in planning/evidence/2026-10-18/audit.md.
      • Register new findings there with severity and evidence.
    • Style: house lint, 80-column prose and roxygen markdown. Match the surrounding code. Ported roadmap tests keep their compact style.
    • Do not edit the README “Use of LLM tools” section. The maintainer writes it.
    • Pushing is a maintainer decision. Commit locally and ask. The maintainer pushes to main directly, with no pull requests, and CI runs on push. The shared workflows live in CTTIR/.github; do not add steps to the callers in .github/workflows/.
